locations.note: Conlin is cut down on the reef in the opening landing at Tarawa; in the finale, now a sergeant, he secures the beachhead and destroys a command centre and the AA guns.
Fresh from boot camp, Conlin arrives to join the USS Arizona on the morning of 7 December 1941.
With the 2nd Marine Raiders Conlin's squad wrecks a radio tower and a supply dump and rescues a downed airman before defending the submarines.
Conlin's squad defends Henderson Field, fights at Edson's Ridge, patrols the Lunga River and has him fly a Dauntless.

routes.name: Pvt. Tommy Conlin
routes.note: Cut down on the Tarawa reef, Conlin relives his war from Pearl Harbor through the Makin raid and Guadalcanal before returning to finish Tarawa as squad leader.
